svg.text: BLUEPRINT 04: DIVERGENCE, CURL, SOLENOIDAL/IRROTATIONAL FIELDS & NULL IDENTITIES
Volumetric Flux Outflow (div F) • Circulation Vorticity (curl F) • The Null Pair DC=0 & CG=0 • Helmholtz Potentials

g.text: The net outward volumetric flux per unit volume at an infinitesimal point:
div(F) = grad . F = dF_x/dx + dF_y/dy + dF_z/dz
F is Solenoidal <==> div(F) = grad . F = 0
<==> F can be expressed as Curl of a Vector Potential: F = grad x A
Magnetic Field B (Gauss's Law for Magnetism):
grad . B = 0 ==> B = grad x A (No Magnetic Monopoles!)
oiint_S F . dS = iiint_V (grad . F) dV = iiint_V (0) dV = 0 (ALWAYS ZERO!)
Fluid enters and exits any arbitrary volume at equal rates; constant density rho.
3. General Law: grad . [ r^n r ] = (n + 3) r^n
When is r^n r Solenoidal? grad . (r^n r) = 0 <==> n + 3 = 0 <==> n = -3
The Inverse-Square Field F = r / r^3 = r_cap / r^2 is SOLENOIDAL everywhere for r != 0!
At r = 0, it features a Dirac Delta singularity: grad . (r / r^3) = 4pi delta^3(r).
The net circulation per unit surface area; measures microscopic rotation:
curl(F) = grad x F = det [ i j k ;
grad x F = (dF_z/dy - dF_y/dz) i + (dF_x/dz - dF_z/dx) j + (dF_y/dx - dF_x/dy) k
Paddle Wheel Physical Test: A tiny paddle wheel placed in the fluid spins iff curl F != 0.
F is Irrotational <==> curl(F) = grad x F = 0
<==> F is Conservative: F can be represented as grad(phi)
Circulation along ANY Closed Loop is Zero:
oint_C F . dl = iint_S (grad x F) . dS = iint_S (0) . dS = 0
int_A^B F . dl = phi(B) - phi(A) (Independent of route taken!)
Vorticity omega = 1/2 (grad x v). Zero curl implies irrotational potential flow.
RADIAL VECTOR CURL INVARIANCE: grad x [ f(r) r ] = 0
grad x [ f(r) r ] = f(r) (grad x r) + grad[f(r)] x r
1. grad x r = det [ i j k ; d/dx d/dy d/dz ; x y z ] = 0 i + 0 j + 0 k = 0
2. grad[f(r)] = [ f'(r)/r ] r ==> grad[f(r)] x r = [ f'(r)/r ] (r x r) = 0
Therefore: grad x [ f(r) r ] == 0 IDENTICALLY!
EVERY CENTRAL FORCE FIELD F = f(r) r_cap IS UNCONDITIONALLY IRROTATIONAL!
Gravity F = -G M m / r^2 r_cap and Coulomb F = k q_1 q_2 / r^2 r_cap have zero curl everywhere.
3. THE NULL PAIR: DC = 0 & CG = 0 ENGINE
THE TWO SACRED VECTOR CALCULUS NULL IDENTITIES
IDENTITY 1: DIVERGENCE OF CURL IS IDENTICALLY ZERO
div( curl F ) = grad . ( grad x F ) == 0
Physical Meaning: Vortex lines form closed loops; they cannot originate from sources or terminate in sinks.
IDENTITY 2: CURL OF GRADIENT IS IDENTICALLY ZERO
curl( grad phi ) = grad x ( grad phi ) == 0
Physical Meaning: Gradient fields are purely conservative; traversing any closed loop generates zero circulation.
Every sufficiently smooth vector field F in R^3 can be uniquely decomposed into:
curl(grad x A) = grad(div A) - grad^2 A
Which of the following fundamental statements are TRUE? (Multiple Select Question):
If vector field F is irrotational, then curl(F) = grad x F = 0.
If vector field F is irrotational, then F can be represented as grad(phi).
If vector field F is solenoidal, then div(F) = grad . F = 0.
If vector field F is solenoidal, then F can be represented as grad x A.
GATE RESULT: ALL 4 OPTIONS (A, B, C, D) ARE CORRECT! [100% SCORE]
